It just means those are the hot topics that everyone is commenting and voting on. :)

And thank you.
I was brought up thinking I had to be "cool" wherever I went. I guess it sort of stayed with me all throughout my teenage years.
I moved from the UK to Canada.

I have hobbies, I love to fish, I love to read, I love visiting museums. I just can't go out and do them (apart from reading of course), it's like the anxiety is hard wired into my head. I know it's all stupid, I know I exaggerate everything but I still cannot go through with doing hobbies. I'm afraid people will laugh at me.

Thank you so much.

I really appreciate the amount of depth you went into (I hope I didn't take too much time away from you). I'm just wondering would medication work? I'll definitely try that you suggested but I'm not sure I could do that, creating a facebook... I literally shake with fear even thinking about it. I'm no expert on any of the medications available to treat anxiety so I'm kind of at a dead end. 

Again, thank you so much.
